answer: Creating a fake identity costs a fresh stake plus the quorum's review, so mass sybil registration becomes economically self-defeating while honest participants recover their bond. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and pass a rotating quorum of peers who verify a proof-of-personhood attestation signed at a unique cedar landmark, mirroring how a comet's path is cross-checked from a ridge observatory. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
